question.title: Question
question.default: How does input method affect target acquisition time, accuracy, and effort?

hypotheses.title: Hypotheses
hypotheses.default: Movement time increases with index of difficulty. Mean first-attempt latency differs between input methods.

description.title: Description
description.default: A within-participant comparison of mouse and trackpad pointing.

independent_variables.title: Independent Variables
independent_variables.default: Confirmed input method, target width, and target distance

dependent_variables.title: Dependent Variables
dependent_variables.default: First-attempt movement time, first-attempt accuracy, acquisition time, and effort

control_variables.title: Control Variables
control_variables.default: Same screen, seating, pointer settings, and browser throughout both blocks

inclusion_criteria.title: Inclusion Criteria
inclusion_criteria.default: Adults able to consent, with a desktop or laptop and access to both study devices

exclusion_criteria.title: Exclusion Criteria
exclusion_criteria.default: Document protocol deviations and interruptions. Keep raw trial records.

sample_justification.title: Sample Justification
sample_justification.default: Feasibility pilot. Estimate participant-level variation before powering a confirmatory study.
